sources.entry: RegexAI - An AI-powered regex pattern generator that creates regular expressions from plain English descriptions with instant testing.

summary.name: RegexAI
summary.one_liner: A free online regex tester and AI builder that generates regular expressions from plain-English descriptions and tests them with live matching.
use_cases: Generate a regex from a plain-English description
Test a regular expression against sample text
Check live matching while writing a pattern
Learn what a pattern matches without signing up
summary.what_it_does: RegexAI lets users describe the text they want to match in plain English and returns a generated regular expression. Users can also paste an existing regex to test it. The tester shows live matching as the pattern is edited. The page describes the service as free and requiring no signup. The page text is brief and does not describe supported regex flavors, export options, or how the AI generation works.
notable: Describe a pattern in plain English to get a regex
Live matching while testing a pasted regex
caveats: Page text is sparse; regex flavor support and limits are not stated
